title: B-tree idle Pager cache clear

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeClearCache delegates cache clearing to Pager only while the shared B-tree has no active transaction.

external_source_responsibilities: Typed Pager owner supplies the cache-clear callback and enforces temporary Pager behavior
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete B-tree transaction guard is assigned and delegates to the translated Pager cache-clear unit.

inputs: B-tree, optional Pager context, and Pager clear callback
contracts.ownership: B-tree and callback context are borrowed.
contracts.state_and_results: Calls clear exactly once when shared.transaction is none; performs no call during read or write transaction.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Invokes one callback only in the idle branch. Caller owns B-tree/Pager synchronization.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible callback contract and no state mutation in the B-tree owner.

representation_differences: The bounded internal B-tree owner receives the Pager clear operation as a typed callback instead of storing a cross-module Pager pointer.

oracle.protocol: Invoke in shared transaction none and observe one callback, switch to read transaction and observe no additional callback.
oracle.normalization: Callback invocation corresponds to sqlite3PagerClearCache entry.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; caller owns synchronization.
assurance.malformed_input: Typed non-null callback and B-tree only.
assurance.continuation: Pure transaction guard; B-tree remains unchanged.
assurance.performance: Constant time plus delegated cache clear when idle.

integration.native_call_path: The idle guard delegates to pager-nontemporary-cache-clear at the typed owner boundary; state matrix is directly traced.

independent_review.notes: Requires native B-tree-to-Pager integration trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Wire direct typed Pager owner into the internal B-tree container or preserve equivalent callback seam in all callers.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:11550-11572 and B-tree clear-cache callers were reviewed
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig transaction state and tests plus pager_core clearCache were reviewed
callers: Connection-wide cache release/flush and VACUUM owners
callees: Typed clear callback targeting pager-nontemporary-cache-clear in Zig
assertions_branches_cleanup: The only generated branch is assigned
No callback is made during active transaction
No allocation or cleanup in this guard
upstream_tests: Upstream B-tree, Pager cache, VACUUM, transaction, and temp tests exercise the guard
Project B-tree/Pager differentials exercise both owners separately
